turns.text: Yeah, hi, Skyline. I need to move my flight. SK212, it leaves at eleven thirty, so can you put me on something later?
I can look into that. First I need to verify your booking. Please give me your booking code and last name.
QW9E4R. Aziz. Look, it's leaving in a couple hours, so just, can you move me?

Thank you, Mr. Aziz. Your SK212 to London leaves at 14:30 today, not 11:30, so you have about four and a half hours. Economy changes cost $75 plus any fare difference, unless you booked within the last 24 hours. Do you know when you booked?
Booked? Uh, I don't know, last week? Just tell me what's leaving today. What's the earliest?
Today's remaining London flights are SK212 at 14:30 and SK214 at 23:55. SK214 is Economy at $380 with nine seats available. Nothing earlier than 14:30 is left today.
Eleven thirty, I said eleven thirty. Okay, the twenty three fifty five, that's midnight, that's, no. Is there any refund if I, what's the, if I don't go?

A refund to your card only applies to flights we cancel or to bookings under 24 hours old. Otherwise the amount becomes a travel credit. A voluntary change on this booking carries the $75 fee if it was made more than 24 hours ago.
Travel credit. That's no good. Okay, forget it, I'm not doing midnight. Is the fourteen thirty delayed? Check that.
I have no delay recorded for SK212, so it is on schedule for 14:30. If you need to change flights, I can arrange a supervisor callback.
Callback? When? I need to know now, I can't wait for a callback.
I can't give you a callback time from this call. You can keep your 14:30 booking as it is, or I can request the callback. Which would you like?
Keep it. Fine. Keep it. Okay, thanks, bye.
